- All actions now support `dry_run` parameter for logging/test runs without side effects.
- Built-in audit logging: every action writes detailed logs to a date-stamped file in `~/.openclaw/skills/desktop-automation-logs/`.
- Macro system fully reworked: robust recording with mouse debouncing and secure, well-structured JSON storage; macro playback supports dry-run and subroutine macros.
- Significantly improved documentation: precise action tables, safety notes, configuration, advanced macro recording, test suite, setup, and troubleshooting.
- All dependencies and core actions now unit-tested (see `scripts/test_automation.py`).
